g.text: U8 ISO7762F: channels A-D carry SCLK, SDI, /CS, /MUTE from the XIAO (3.3 V) to the PGAs (5 V);

g.desc: U8 ISO7762F: channels A-D carry SCLK, SDI, /CS, /MUTE from the XIAO (3.3 V) to the PGAs (5 V);

g.text: E and F bring the plug-sense lines back. Side 1 runs from the XIAO 3V3 pin, side 2 from +5VA.

g.desc: E and F bring the plug-sense lines back. Side 1 runs from the XIAO 3V3 pin, side 2 from +5VA.

g.text: F suffix = outputs fall to 0 when the other side is unpowered: the PGAs stay muted until the XIAO is up.

g.desc: F suffix = outputs fall to 0 when the other side is unpowered: the PGAs stay muted until the XIAO is up.

g.text: The RP2040 pins are not 5 V tolerant, so side 1 must stay on 3.3 V.

g.desc: The RP2040 pins are not 5 V tolerant, so side 1 must stay on 3.3 V.

g.text: Bypass at U8: C39 on VCC1 (USB side), C44 on VCC2 (audio side).

g.desc: Bypass at U8: C39 on VCC1 (USB side), C44 on VCC2 (audio side).

g.text: MIDI activity LED on D9 (GP4), about 2 mA. USB side.

g.desc: MIDI activity LED on D9 (GP4), about 2 mA. USB side.

g.text: R15 holds both PGA2310s muted until the firmware writes its first gains: no power-on thump. Audio side, after U8.

g.desc: R15 holds both PGA2310s muted until the firmware writes its first gains: no power-on thump. Audio side, after U8.

g.text: U9 is a Seeed XIAO RP2040 on header pins. Pin numbers are Seeed's: 1-7 down the left row from the USB end, 8-14 up the right row.

g.desc: U9 is a Seeed XIAO RP2040 on header pins. Pin numbers are Seeed's: 1-7 down the left row from the USB end, 8-14 up the right row.

g.text: Its USB-C is the only connector: class-compliant MIDI in (TinyUSB), 5 V in. The 5V pin is USB VBUS straight through, so it feeds the board.

g.desc: Its USB-C is the only connector: class-compliant MIDI in (TinyUSB), 5 V in. The 5V pin is USB VBUS straight through, so it feeds the board.

g.text: SPI0: D8 (GP2) SCK, D10 (GP3) MOSI, D7 (GP1) /CS, D6 (GP0) /MUTE. D9 (GP4, the MISO pin) drives the LED: bit-bang the 32-bit frame or leave SPI RX unassigned.

g.desc: SPI0: D8 (GP2) SCK, D10 (GP3) MOSI, D7 (GP1) /CS, D6 (GP0) /MUTE. D9 (GP4, the MISO pin) drives the LED: bit-bang the 32-bit frame or leave SPI RX unassigned.

g.text: Nothing on the XIAO touches the audio ground: the four control lines and two sense lines cross U8, power crosses PS1. GND_USB is the USB-side ground.

g.desc: Nothing on the XIAO touches the audio ground: the four control lines and two sense lines cross U8, power crosses PS1. GND_USB is the USB-side ground.

g.text: DIP switch on D2-D5 (GP28, GP29, GP6, GP7), closed = 0, internal pull-ups on. Plug sense on D0, D1 (GP26, GP27), internal pull-ups off (100k to +5VA on sheet 1).

g.desc: DIP switch on D2-D5 (GP28, GP29, GP6, GP7), closed = 0, internal pull-ups on. Plug sense on D0, D1 (GP26, GP27), internal pull-ups off (100k to +5VA on sheet 1).
